title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十七章、最好的朋友

    包拯和公孙策在牛村见到了王铁。王铁正在种菜，听说包拯是来找他的，他有点儿吃惊。
    王铁仔细看了看包拯，疑惑地问：“您是开封府的包大人？您找我有什么事？”
    “你还记得高小山吗？我们想问问你一些关于他的事情。”
    “高小山……”王铁的神情变得很复杂，他低头想了想，问道：“您是从侍卫营来的吗？小山的死和八王爷被绑架的事情有关吗？
    “你知道八王爷被绑架的事？”包拯有点儿吃惊。
    “前两天挂在西市菜市场门头上的那件血衣，我看到了，那天早上我去西市卖菜了。”说完，王铁放下了手里的菜，弯腰道：“包大人，公孙大人，请进屋！不管你们问什么，我都会把我知道的告诉你们。”
    包拯和公孙策跟着王铁进了屋。屋子里有点儿乱，衣服随便放在床上，地面也没有打扫。“对不起，早上去卖菜了，刚刚回来，还来不及整理房间。”王铁一边说一边搬来椅子请包拯和公孙策坐。
    “没关系。王铁，你母亲还好吗？”包拯问。
    王铁说：“二十一年前，我从侍卫营回来没多久，我母亲就去世了。这些年我是一个人过的，平时种菜、卖菜，过得不好也不坏。”
    “对不起。”包拯坐下来问道：“时间过去很久了，高小山的事情，你还记得多少？”
    “虽然小山比我小三岁，也比我晚两年来侍卫营，但他是我在侍卫营最好的朋友，他的每一件事我都记得，您想问哪一件？”
    “他是被谁杀死的？”包拯直接问道。
    王铁有点儿吃惊，但很快就回答道：“刘妃宫里的大太监张怀。”
    “张怀杀了高小山？什么时候？为什么杀人？”
    “包大人，您知道二十一年前冷宫发生过一场火灾吗？小山就是在火灾那天晚上被张怀杀死的，杀人原因是因为小山私放了一个宫女和一个太监出宫。”
    “宫女和太监？”
    “是的，怎么了？”王铁疑惑地问。
    包拯没有回答，而是追问道：“高小山为什么要私放他们出宫？他认识他们吗？”
    “小山来侍卫营还不到一年，他应该不认识他们。当时冷宫着火了，宫里一片慌乱，侍卫营的侍卫都被叫去救火了。那个宫女和太监想在混乱中偷偷出宫，被小山发现了。他们很慌张，跪下来求小山。善良的小山被他们说动了，放了他们。没多久，张怀带人来侍卫营查问，说有人看到侍卫营的侍卫私放了有罪的宫女和太监出宫。如果没有人承认，张怀就要抓走当晚所有值班的侍卫。小山为了不连累大家，主动站了出来。”
fullText.traditional:
第十七章、最好的朋友

    包拯和公孫策在牛村見到了王鐵。王鐵正在種菜，聽說包拯是來找他的，他有點兒吃驚。
    王鐵仔細看了看包拯，疑惑地問：“您是開封府的包大人？您找我有什麼事？”
    “你還記得高小山嗎？我們想問問你一些關於他的事情。”
    “高小山……”王鐵的神情變得很複雜，他低頭想了想，問道：“您是從侍衛營來的嗎？小山的死和八王爺被綁架的事情有關嗎？
    “你知道八王爺被綁架的事？”包拯有點兒吃驚。
    “前兩天掛在西市菜市場門頭上的那件血衣，我看到了，那天早上我去西市賣菜了。”說完，王鐵放下了手裡的菜，彎腰道：“包大人，公孫大人，請進屋！不管你們問什麼，我都會把我知道的告訴你們。”
    包拯和公孫策跟著王鐵進了屋。屋子裡有點兒亂，衣服隨便放在床上，地面也沒有打掃。“對不起，早上去賣菜了，剛剛回來，還來不及整理房間。”王鐵一邊說一邊搬來椅子請包拯和公孫策坐。
    “沒關係。王鐵，你母親還好嗎？”包拯問。
    王鐵說：“二十一年前，我從侍衛營回來沒多久，我母親就去世了。這些年我是一個人過的，平時種菜、賣菜，過得不好也不壞。”
    “對不起。”包拯坐下來問道：“時間過去很久了，高小山的事情，你還記得多少？”
    “雖然小山比我小三歲，也比我晚兩年來侍衛營，但他是我在侍衛營最好的朋友，他的每一件事我都記得，您想問哪一件？”
    “他是被誰殺死的？”包拯直接問道。
    王鐵有點兒吃驚，但很快就回答道：“劉妃宮裡的大太監張懷。”
    “張懷殺了高小山？什麼時候？為什麼殺人？”
    “包大人，您知道二十一年前冷宮發生過一場火災嗎？小山就是在火災那天晚上被張懷殺死的，殺人原因是因為小山私放了一個宮女和一個太監出宮。”
    “宮女和太監？”
    “是的，怎麼了？”王鐵疑惑地問。
    包拯沒有回答，而是追問道：“高小山為什麼要私放他們出宮？他認識他們嗎？”
    “小山來侍衛營還不到一年，他應該不認識他們。當時冷宮著火了，宮裡一片慌亂，侍衛營的侍衛都被叫去救火了。那個宮女和太監想在混亂中偷偷出宮，被小山發現了。他們很慌張，跪下來求小山。善良的小山被他們說動了，放了他們。沒多久，張懷帶人來侍衛營查問，說有人看到侍衛營的侍衛私放了有罪的宮女和太監出宮。如果沒有人承認，張懷就要抓走當晚所有值班的侍衛。小山為了不連累大家，主動站了出來。”

sentences.simplified: “小山来侍卫营还不到一年，他应该不认识他们。
sentences.traditional: “小山來侍衛營還不到一年，他應該不認識他們。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo shān lái shì wèi yíng hái bú dào yì nián tā yīng gāi bú rèn shi tā men
sentences.english: “Xiaoshan had been in the imperial guard camp for less than a year. He probably didn’t know them.

sentences.simplified: 当时冷宫着火了，宫里一片慌乱，
sentences.traditional: 當時冷宮著火了，宮裡一片慌亂，
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí lěng gōng zháo huǒ le gōng lǐ yí piàn huāng luàn
sentences.english: At that time, the Cold Palace caught fire, and the palace was in chaos.

sentences.simplified: 侍卫营的侍卫都被叫去救火了。
sentences.traditional: 侍衛營的侍衛都被叫去救火了。
sentences.pinyin: shì wèi yíng de shì wèi dōu bèi jiào qù jiù huǒ le
sentences.english: The guards from the imperial guard camp were all called to put out the fire.

sentences.simplified: 那个宫女和太监想在混乱中偷偷出宫，被小山发现了。
sentences.traditional: 那個宮女和太監想在混亂中偷偷出宮，被小山發現了。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge gōng nǚ hé tài jiàn xiǎng zài hùn luàn zhōng tōu tōu chū gōng bèi xiǎo shān fā xiàn le
sentences.english: In the midst of the chaos, the palace maid and the eunuch tried to sneak out of the palace, but Xiaoshan caught them.

sentences.simplified: 他们很慌张，跪下来求小山。
sentences.traditional: 他們很慌張，跪下來求小山。
sentences.pinyin: tā men hěn huāng zhāng guì xià lái qiú xiǎo shān
sentences.english: They were panicked and knelt down to beg Xiaoshan.

sentences.simplified: 善良的小山被他们说动了，放了他们。
sentences.traditional: 善良的小山被他們說動了，放了他們。
sentences.pinyin: shàn liáng de xiǎo shān bèi tā men shuō dòng le fàng le tā men
sentences.english: The kind-hearted Xiaoshan was persuaded by them and let them go.

sentences.simplified: 没多久，张怀带人来侍卫营查问，
sentences.traditional: 沒多久，張懷帶人來侍衛營查問，
sentences.pinyin: méi duō jiǔ zhāng huái dài rén lái shì wèi yíng chá wèn
sentences.english: Before long, Zhang Huai brought people to the imperial guard camp to investigate, ..

sentences.simplified: 说有人看到侍卫营的侍卫
sentences.traditional: 說有人看到侍衛營的侍衛
sentences.pinyin: shuō yǒu rén kàn dào shì wèi yíng de shì wèi
sentences.english: .. saying that someone had seen a guard of the imperial guard camp ..

sentences.simplified: 私放了有罪的宫女和太监出宫。
sentences.traditional: 私放了有罪的宮女和太監出宮。
sentences.pinyin: sī fàng le yǒu zuì de gōng nǚ hé tài jiàn chū gōng
sentences.english: .. secretly letting a guilty palace maid and eunuch leave the palace.

sentences.simplified: 如果没有人承认，张怀就要抓走当晚所有值班的侍卫。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有人承認，張懷就要抓走當晚所有值班的侍衛。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ méi yǒu rén chéng rèn zhāng huái jiù yào zhuā zǒu dàng wǎn suǒ yǒu zhí bān de shì wèi
sentences.english: If no one confessed, Zhang Huai would have arrested all the guards on duty that night.

sentences.simplified: 小山为了不连累大家，主动站了出来。”
sentences.traditional: 小山為了不連累大家，主動站了出來。”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo shān wèi le bù lián lěi dà jiā zhǔ dòng zhàn le chu lai
sentences.english: Xiaoshan stepped forward voluntarily so as not to implicate everyone else.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 17: Best Friend
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce met Wang Tie in Niu Village.
Wang Tie was planting vegetables. He was a bit surprised to hear that Bao Zheng was coming to see him.
Wang Tie looked closely at Bao Zheng and asked in confusion, “Are you Lord Bao from Kaifeng Prefecture? What do you need from me?”
“Do you still remember Gao Xiaoshan? We want to ask you some questions about him.”
“Gao Xiaoshan …” Wang Tie’s expression became very complex.
He lowered his head to think for a moment, then asked, ..
.. “Are you from the imperial guard camp? Is Xiaoshan’s death related to the kidnapping of the Eighth Prince?”
“You know about the kidnapping of the Eighth Prince?” Bao Zheng was quite surprised.
“I saw the bloodstained garment hanging over the gate of the West Market a couple of days ago.
I went to sell vegetables at the West Market that morning.”
After speaking, Wang Tie put down the vegetables in his hand and bowed, saying, “Lord Bao, Lord Gongsun, please come in!
No matter what you ask, I will tell you what I know.”
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce followed Wang Tie into the house.
The house was a bit messy, with clothes casually thrown on the bed and the floor unswept.
“Sorry, I went to sell vegetables this morning and just got back, so I haven’t had time to tidy up the room.”
As Wang Tie spoke, he brought over chairs and invited Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce to sit.
“It’s okay. Wang Tie, how is your mother doing?” Bao Zheng asked.
Wang Tie said, “Twenty-one years ago, not long after I returned from the imperial guard camp, my mother passed away.
These past years, I’ve been living alone, growing and selling vegetables. Life hasn’t been great, but it hasn’t been bad either.”
“I’m sorry.” Bao Zheng sat down and asked, ..
.. “It’s been a long time. How much do you still remember about what happened to Gao Xiaoshan?”
“Although Xiaoshan was three years younger than me and joined the imperial guard camp two years later than I did, ..
.. he was my best friend in the imperial guard camp.
I remember everything about him. What would you like to ask about?”
“Who killed him?” Bao Zheng asked directly.
Wang Tie was quite surprised, but quickly replied, “The chief eunuch Zhang Huai in Consort Liu’s palace.”
“Zhang Huai killed Gao Xiaoshan? When? Why was he killed?”
“Lord Bao, do you know that there was a fire in the Cold Palace twenty-one years ago?
Xiaoshan was killed by Zhang Huai on the night of the fire.
The reason for the murder was that Xiaoshan had secretly let a palace maid and a eunuch out of the palace.”
“A palace maid and a eunuch?”
“Yes, what about it?” Wang Tie asked in confusion.
Bao Zheng did not answer, but instead kept on asking, ..
.. “Why did Gao Xiaoshan secretly let them out of the palace? Did he know them?”
“Xiaoshan had been in the imperial guard camp for less than a year. He probably didn’t know them.
At that time, the Cold Palace caught fire, and the palace was in chaos.
The guards from the imperial guard camp were all called to put out the fire.
In the midst of the chaos, the palace maid and the eunuch tried to sneak out of the palace, but Xiaoshan caught them.
They were panicked and knelt down to beg Xiaoshan.
The kind-hearted Xiaoshan was persuaded by them and let them go.
Before long, Zhang Huai brought people to the imperial guard camp to investigate, ..
.. saying that someone had seen a guard of the imperial guard camp ..
.. secretly letting a guilty palace maid and eunuch leave the palace.
If no one confessed, Zhang Huai would have arrested all the guards on duty that night.
Xiaoshan stepped forward voluntarily so as not to implicate everyone else.”
